verdict_rationale: All cited source institutions and competency IDs are 100% referentially valid and authentic. However, 0 of the 26 cases represent 'exact_course_verified' iGOT session plans locally. 12 cases represent 'official_related_material' (apex institute curricula covering the subject), 5 cases represent 'possible_match_needs_verification', and 9 cases represent 'access_restricted'. Furthermore, the Domain-gap claim for HCES and ASI must be categorized as potential_domain_gap_requires_adjudication due to conceptual overlap with KCM-FUNC-11 (Data Analytics), rather than an automatic algorithmic zero-match.

cases.audit_finding: MoSPI HCES factsheets and NSSTA training manuals confirm survey methodology (NSS Schedule 1.0, sampling weights, MPCE computation).
